prompt.generated_prompt_string: Reversal comedy in realistic movie HD texture. At an internet-famous milk-tea shop counter, an adult customer takes a packed fruit tea from an adult assistant in a uniform apron and cap. She asks whether he will drink it there or take it away; he says, "Take away." She replies, "Okay, have a nice day." He theatrically misunderstands and says, "I meant take the drink away—sorry!" She freezes with a professional smile while a crow or string-snap sound effect marks the reversal. He immediately places the drink back on the counter and apologizes; she points him toward the exit with a deadpan look. Transition to the street where he rides an electric scooter with the milk tea in its holder, proudly announcing that he ordered takeaway, while the assistant waves from the shop doorway. Keep the humor consensual and do not show grabbing or forced transport.
